sources.title: Nova Mini — Text AI Model
sources.snippet: Nova Mini is Nova's most cost-efficient proprietary model, designed for classification, routing, and lightweight instruction-following tasks at high throughput. It's the right pick for pipelines where millions of short requests need fast, cheap decisions. Try Nova Mini in the playground or call it via API from $0.05 / M tokens.
